artifacts.section: Input artifacts twenty · consumed by the process
rows: L1–L3 abilities the business possesses. Each L3 carries name (verb-plus-object), accountable executive, maturity, performance gap, strategic criticality, AI candidacy, and its KPIs as attributes. Four tests: org-independence, outsourcing-independence, MECE at each level, stable noun phrase. Example: "Assess Contractual Exposure", Supply Chain Director, maturity repeatable, gap materially below, criticality competitive, KPI mean time to exposure assessment.
Assess — does one exist at L3, and is it org-independent?

What AI building blocks can do — domain → capability → product, with a primary and substitutable alternatives. A to-be selection catalogue: what could be used, not what runs. Example: Knowledge → federated retrieval → Foundry IQ primary, Azure AI Search direct alternative.
Adapted — capability-map pattern applied to AI

What non-AI systems can do, by abstract type not product — incident management, ERP, EHR, master data, event source, identity, notification, document store, data platform, audit store. Portability depends on this.
Assess — usually exists as a portfolio; may need typing

What AI services are actually deployed. Per entry: service name, consumers, offered behaviour, current service level, owned entities, failure semantics, operator. Example: "Classify Incident" — consumer ITSM triage flow, 2s p95, owns nothing, at-most-once, operated by AI Platform.
Optional — falls back to the capability map, then survey
Same schema, for deployed non-AI systems. The instance behind the type: not "an incident management system" but the one you run, its level and its operator.

Concepts with relationships, rules and data bindings; vocabulary register; conflict log. Every concept a step reasons over must be defined, related, ruled and bound to real data — a term with no binding fails the semantic gate. Example: Shipment, with warehouse_arrived_at and customer_received_at split after a logged conflict.
Domain stewards own concepts; Ontology Council owns the model and arbitrates
Assess — most commonly absent, most expensive to retrofit

A classification overlay on systems already inventoried, not a second estate list. Per source: sensitivity, permission scope and propagation, freshness (static, periodic, dynamic, time-critical), provenance and trust. Example: contract library — Confidential, ops and compliance, static daily index, authoritative.
Contract the sources (E0.8) ; knowledge gate (Q0.8) ; retrieval contract (G06)
Enterprise risk entries that step-level risks map to. Every step risk maps to an entry or creates one; a step risk with no plausible register home is usually a typing error.
Assess — usually exists; the AI linkage rarely does
Four gates — business grounding, semantic readiness, knowledge readiness, criticality — with evidence per gate and three verdicts. Conditional unavailable for safety-of-life.
Three classes with the rigor each sets, the heterogeneous-population rule, and the pre-triage router constraint.
Assign criticality (E0.9) ; carry forward (Q0.9) ; escalation (Q3.4) ; operate (Q7.2)
Seven criteria predicting non-determinism, five counter-indicators, reducibility flags. Grows from logged classification overrides.
Nine facets, defaults per activity verb, exposure derivation (base, modifiers, floor, cap), influence read along data flow with attenuation, four-point class scale.
Twenty-six issued, twenty-four live, each with trigger predicate, obligation, enforcement point, evidence artifact, failure mode. Plus six opportunity obligations, warn-and-log only.
Agent Council, with security and responsible AI
Adapted — the first ten OWASP ASI-aligned
Mandatory set per exposure and influence class over a baseline. Answers "we are exposure 2 and influence 3 — what applies".
Eighteen surface-sensitive obligations across five surfaces. Six invariants named as surface-independent.
Choose the surface (Q4.2) ; can it enforce (Q4.3)
Tradeoff catalogue and decision record schema
Eight known conflicts with usual resolutions; a record schema whose load-bearing field is what was sacrificed. Grows from practice.
Quality attribute form and envelope patterns

Six-part scenario — source, stimulus, environment, artifact, response, response measure. Six patterns, four derived and two chosen, with mutual constraints. Levels taken from existing business commitments, never invented.
Business service owners for levels; Architecture Board for patterns
Surfaces, when to use each, hosting, including the incumbent-platform and non-Microsoft rows.
Four topologies × fourteen derived component families × three modifiers, plus the five-move composition procedure.
Agent Council; Board for deployment baselines
Stages zero to seven, the behavioural artifact. Each item typed as pre-work, decision or gate.
